description:
This API endpoint allows users to update their profile information. The HTTP POST request should be made to [https://genie.aimtech.online/api/v1/users/profile](https://genie.aimtech.online/api/v1/users/profile). The request should include a form-data request body with the necessary parameters to update the user's profile.

### Request Body

- No specific parameters were provided for the form-data request body.
    

### Response

The response will contain the updated profile information for the user.
